data:
# 1. Force-kill the AI services holding the mic lock
am force-stop com.motorola.assistant
am force-stop com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox
# 2. Flush the Smart Voice/CrystalTalk buffer
am force-stop com.motorola.smartvoice
# 3. Check for the 'Mute' flag in the system state
dumpsys audio | grep "mFinishedQuietly"
